about: A room with platforms, racks and enough plates that nobody waits. Sessions are coached: somebody is watching the bar and telling you what to change on the next set.
Most people who train here are not athletes. They are people who want to carry things, get off the floor easily and not dread their sixties.

faq.q: I have never lifted before. Is that a problem?
faq.a: No. The beginner block exists for exactly that, and everyone here has done it.
Groups and one-to-one, yes. Open training you can walk into any time we are open.
